headline:
On earth
as it is in heaven.
headline_sub: Every project is a community hearing the Word in its own voice. Track progress, health and field-team needs.

f_iso_hint: An ISO 639-3 code has three letters. The value is stored exactly as typed.
f_coords_hint: Longitude and latitude in decimal degrees. Left blank, the project is plotted at its region's centre.
d_coords_missing: No coordinates — plotted at the region's centre
f_sensitive_on_map: On the Atlas the project is plotted at its region's centre, never at the real place, and only coordination sees how many projects are being withheld.
f_sensitive_on_cards: On cards and in the record, anyone outside coordination sees the region in place of the country and the location, without the base or the contacts; the prayer wall, notifications and exports never carry the place or the base.
f_sensitive_on_pending: The {{lab}} does not read the notes, the health notes, the status comments, the scope details, the needs' descriptions and notes, the notes on the objective and the finances, the partner organisation, the status goal, the photo and video captions or the recording place: it receives them blank. Coordination and the {{circle}} read everything. The project phases and the details for "Other" resources stay in plain sight: do not write the project's place there.
f_location_coordination_only: Only coordination — the region's {{regional}} and the {{admin}} — edits the location, the coordinates and the sensitive-country flag; in a sensitive country, only coordination sees the real place, the base and the contacts.
f_free_text_coordination_only: On a sensitive project, the notes, the health notes, the status comments, the scope details, the needs' descriptions and notes, the notes on the objective and the finances, the partner organisation, the status goal, the photo and video captions and the recording place are edited only by coordination — the region's {{regional}} and the {{admin}} — and also read by the {{circle}}. They reach the {{lab}} blank, and blank does not mean nobody wrote them.

media_auth_sensitive: Sensitive country: even an authorized item stays out of any public-facing output — the most restrictive rule wins. What the flag protects today is described in the Identity tab.

int_withheld_count_other: {{count}} people in the network are not shown because they have not consented to being listed.

int_withheld_review_due_other: Among the people not shown, {{count}} have gone over a year without use. As they did not consent to being listed, they cannot be reviewed here — raise it with coordination.

forms_eyebrow: Field forms · Where to find them
forms_lead: Two forms bring news from the teams, each in its own time. Pick the project to see what each one asks, who fills it in, and how the answer comes back.
forms_footnote: The Monthly Pulse is a form the leader fills in alone on a phone, with no connectivity, and returns. The Health Assessment opens inside the app, run by the Facilitator during the meeting with the team.
forms_received_empty: No forms archived yet. Once importing arrives, every filled form is kept here exactly as it came, for you to download anytime.
forms_pulse_desc: It starts with the person, not the numbers: the team speaks first, shows a photo, and only then records the chapters. Works offline on the phone and saves by itself.
forms_pulse_mechanism: Leaves the app as a form, comes back filled in over WhatsApp or email.
forms_health_desc: Not the leader alone: the Facilitator runs a live conversation with the team, walking through four dimensions of life in the field — emotional, relational, spiritual and physical.
forms_health_mechanism: Opens inside the app during the meeting. It produces no file at all: nothing is downloaded, sent or returned.
forms_mechanism_file: A file that leaves and returns
forms_step_generate_detail: here in the Forms tab, choosing the project.
forms_step_send_detail: to the field leader, over WhatsApp or email.
forms_step_answer_detail: on the phone, with no connectivity, and returns the filled form.
forms_step_import_detail: and Progress, Team Health and Needs update themselves.
forms_step_archive_detail: the filled form is kept, and coordination is notified straight away.
forms_q_voice: How was this month? — the team’s voice, as audio or text.
forms_q_photo: Show the work. — a photo of the team, the elders or the printed material.
forms_q_chapters: Chapters closed. — translated, community-checked and approved.
forms_q_blockers: Is anything in the way? — what is missing this month: resources, equipment, training.
forms_q_prayer: What do we carry in prayer? — with explicit authorization for the intercessor network.

forms_pending_none: Every project has already reported in the current {{form}} cycle.

forms_loop_open: For {{project}}, this period’s loop still starts at “You generate”.
forms_format_pending: The Pulse file format is still being settled with the client, so no screen promises one.
forms_actions_pending: The leader link can already be generated — it's the header's Leader link action. Applying an answer to the project record still arrives in wave 2. For now this screen shows the loop, what each form asks, and who has not reported yet.

oracao_lead: Every prayer request — from the Monthly Pulse and the Health Assessments — gathered here to share with intercessor groups around the world.
oracao_empty: No prayer requests yet. When teams submit the forms, requests appear here.
oracao_footnote: TXT to share with groups · CSV and JSON for the intercession database. Requests come from both forms (Monthly Pulse and Health Assessment).
oracao_revisao_lead: Requests from sensitive projects that the team shared with the network. They reach the wall and the Pulse only after the coordination releases them, and you may adjust the text first.
oracao_revisao_text_label: Text that goes to the wall
oracao_revisao_released: Request released to the wall and the Pulse.
eten_lead: ETEN funds most of Shema's resources. Each year we report how far each project advanced. Each completed defined scope is worth 1 credit — and the credit total corresponds to the next cycle's resources. Only projects on the ETEN list are counted.
eten_credits_note: 1 completed scope = 1 credit, in the fiscal year it closed
eten_empty: No projects marked on the ETEN list. Mark "Language on ETEN list" in each project form.
eten_footnote: Credit is per completed defined scope, counted in approved chapters: a 25-chapter project and a 260-chapter New Testament are worth 1 credit each, on closing their own scope. Update each project's progress for it to reach the report. The year is ETEN’s fiscal year, from 1 August to 31 July: a scope that closes on 31/07 counts in the year ending there, and one that closes on 1 August, in the next. Each of the project’s partners receives the whole credit.
eten_year_no_data: No listed project has progress recorded by the end of fiscal year {{year}}. A year with no data is not a year of zero credits — the two mean different things to the funder.
eten_undated_note: The project is marked completed, but it has no recorded completion date and the progress readings do not show the year its scope closed — the credit could not be attributed to a year. A credit entered by hand by coordination, for the right year, settles the line.
eten_export_pending: The CSV export and the PDF report arrive in wave 2.
eten_period: Fiscal year from {{start}} to {{end}} — the cut-off is 31 July.
eten_not_recorded: This calculation was not recorded on the server: it is this browser's demonstration data.
eten_unverified: approved count from the import, not verified
eten_unverified_note: This project's approved chapters came from the Notion spreadsheet. Readings before the first save that changed them do not count towards the credit.
eten_breakdown_lead: Every credit of the year, down to the project and the record that produced it.
eten_breakdown_empty: No project closed its own scope in this fiscal year.
ritmo_lead: Shema means "listen". Each meeting is a step of that listening — information flows from the field to leadership, and care flows back. Forms feed the meetings; meetings feed the decisions.
ritmo_pulso_unread: The received Pulses could not be read yet, so the count of who sent it back is not shown — it is not zero, it is unknown.
forms_pulses_unread: The received Pulses could not be read yet. Who sent it back and who is missing appear once the reading arrives — until then, nothing here says anyone has not reported.
ritmo_readiness: Teams that already reported this period
ritmo_flow_note: Information flows from the field to leadership → · ← care and resources flow back
ritmo_notes_kept: Anything you type is kept, even if you close without saving.
ritmo_log_unread: The meeting log could not be read yet, so no row says whether a meeting is up to date — not because it never happened, but because we do not know yet.
ritmo_log_forbidden: The meeting log holds how the teams are doing, and is read by {{coordinator}} and {{obtLab}} — that is why it does not appear for your role.
ritmo_no_projects_reach: No projects in the regions you follow — their meetings appear as soon as there is one.
ritmo_no_projects: No projects yet — the meetings appear as soon as the first region has any.
ritmo_bimestral_desc: Every two months, the International Projects team meets the field team: an overall review, with the period’s forms in hand, and a conversation about how the team is doing.
ritmo_trimestral_desc: Every quarter, the International Projects team meets the bridge people of each region.
ritmo_semestral_desc: Every six months, Member Care holds a debriefing with the field team.
ritmo_pulso_desc: Not a meeting: it is the form each project’s leader sends back every month. It counts as returned when it arrives and is archived — updating the project record does not count.
ritmo_pulso_where: Who has not sent it back yet, project by project, is under Forms.
ritmo_celebracao_desc: Not a meeting: it is the year’s report — how many projects started and how many finished, by region.
relatorio_lead: What was done during the year: how many projects started and how many finished, in each region.
relatorio_no_data: No project has a start or completion date recorded, so {{year}} has no data. A year with no data is not a year with no project started.
relatorio_undated_one: 1 project is marked as completed with no completion date, so it enters no year.
relatorio_undated_other: {{count}} projects are marked as completed with no completion date, so they enter no year.
relatorio_calendar_note: This report’s year is the calendar year, January to December, until it is confirmed which year the Celebration should use. The goals the teams reached come in once there is somewhere to record them.
ritmo_feed_field_check: The period’s forms and the Health Assessment
ritmo_feed_member_care: Care for the team over the half-year
ritmo_participants_pending: The bridge people have not been defined yet. For now, the meeting is organized by the roles above, with no list of names.

placeholder_financial_notes: Notes about the project's financial situation...
f_base_hint: YWAM and JOCUM are the same name in two languages. Whatever is written here holds for both fields on the record.
f_people_hint: Separate with commas, or add one at a time.
f_roles_hint: These three names come from the region's org chart, not from this record. They change in one place and hold for every project in the region.
f_contact_sensitive: Project flagged as a sensitive country. These contacts are personal data — the Identity tab describes what the flag protects today.
f_members_empty: No account is a member of this project yet.

health_q_relational: How are things between you as a team?
health_q_spiritual: How is the walk with God?
health_lead: Four questions for listening to the team. None of them needs an answer today — leaving one blank says it has not been talked about yet.
health_care_critical: This team asked for help. Critical is not a low score — it is a call to care.
health_care_attention: This team signalled strain. Worth a conversation before the next assessment.
health_never_assessed: This team has not been through a health conversation yet. Until then the project is not counted as well — it is counted as not yet heard.
hq_emotional_1: How have you been sleeping this month?
hq_emotional_2: Is anything taking away your sleep or your peace?
hq_emotional_3: Where have you been finding rest?
hq_emotional_4: Is there a personal situation weighing on you right now?
hq_relational_1: Have you had conflicts left unresolved?
hq_relational_2: How are you caring for one another?
hq_relational_3: Is anyone on the team isolated?
hq_relational_4: How is the relationship with the local community?
hq_spiritual_1: How has the team’s prayer life been?
hq_spiritual_2: Are you able to gather to worship?
hq_spiritual_3: What is God saying in the project right now?
hq_spiritual_4: Is there an area of spiritual battle?
hq_physical_1: Is anyone dealing with health problems right now?
hq_physical_2: How is food? Access to water?
hq_physical_3: Have you been able to rest physically?
hq_physical_4: Any security risk in the territory?
hw_howto: Each dimension brings questions to talk through with the team. Rate at the end of the block and write down what you heard. No field is required and nothing blocks your way.
hw_no_file: Nothing here produces a file: the assessment happens inside the app, and nothing is downloaded, sent or returned.
hw_questions_source: The questions come from the Facilitator’s script; they are not generated by the system.
hw_note_placeholder: What the team said in this dimension…
hw_note_matters: This note matters more than the rating: the rating is a label, what was said is what gets kept.
hw_skip_note: Skipping is a legitimate answer: it records as not assessed, never as well.
hw_resumed: Picked up where you left off, on {{date}}.
hw_overall_note_placeholder: Something that cuts across the four dimensions…
hw_pastoral_suggested: The system suggests pastoral care because of this:
hw_pastoral_not_applied: The suggestion does not apply itself. It waits here until you decide — the system proposes, a person confirms.
hw_pastoral_quiet: No dimension called for pastoral care. You can still suggest it, if the conversation asked for it.
hw_pastoral_who_placeholder: E.g. Daniel — field visit in June
hw_prayer_title: Did the team raise a prayer request?
hw_prayer_placeholder: What the team asked to be carried in prayer…
hw_prayer_optional: Optional. Left blank, nothing is created.
hw_not_found: Project not found. Go back to Forms and pick a project.

hw_overallnote_local_only: Stays only in this draft, in your browser — today this is not sent with the assessment.

export_sub: The file leaves ready to be passed on — so it leaves reduced.
export_contains: Shemá Ecosystem projects — identity, scope, progress, health, open needs and shared prayer requests. No personal contacts, internal notes or media.
export_confidential: Confidential — for the coordination's internal use. Do not pass it on without agreeing with the responsible team.
import_desc: The file is checked first: either it goes in whole, or nothing changes. Any error rejects the entire import.
import_invalid_json: The file could not be read as JSON.
import_is_export: This file is the exported report — reduced on purpose, it cannot restore the projects.
import_not_list: The content is not a list of projects.

receive_desc: The leader's answer comes back from the field and is applied to the project — progress, health and needs enter the record, and the received file is kept exactly as it arrived.
receive_pending: Importing the answer arrives in wave 2. For now, the Forms area shows the Pulse loop and who has not reported yet.
intake_sub: Monthly Pulse by link, straight from the field.
intake_desc: The link opens the Monthly Pulse for the team leader to fill on their phone, no console account needed.
intake_scope: Scope: only this project's Pulse. The link opens no console and shows no project data beyond the language name.
intake_expiry: Validity: the link expires, can be used more than once before then, and can be revoked at any time.
intake_link_once: Copy it now — for safety, this address is shown here only once.
intake_links_empty: No link generated for this project yet.

intake_form_check_answers: Check the flagged answers before sending.
intake_form_reload_needed: This form changed since you opened the link. Reload the page before sending.
intake_form_offline_hint: If the connection drops, your answer stays saved here — just try sending it again.

intake_link_expired_body: Every link lasts for a while. Ask your coordinator for a new one to send this month's Pulse.
intake_link_revoked_body: Your coordinator canceled this link. Ask for a new one to send your answer.
intake_link_invalid_title: We could not find this link
intake_link_invalid_body: Check that you copied the address correctly, or ask your coordinator for a new link.
intake_err_period: Use the year-month format, for example 2026-09.
intake_err_too_long: This answer is too long — trim it a bit.
intake_err_server: The server did not accept this answer.
forms_q_submitted_by: Who is answering? — your name, so we know who told us about the month.
forms_q_period: Which month is this Pulse about?
forms_q_prayer_visibility: Can this request reach the intercessor network, or should it stay with coordination only?
net_offline: No connection to the server. What you already saved is kept in this browser; try again when the network is back.
net_timeout: The server took too long to answer. The connection is slow, not down — wait a moment and try again. Nothing was lost.
net_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again to carry on — what you were filling in is still here.
net_forbidden: Your account has no access to this part of Shemá. Ask the Platform admin to grant the role and the region.
net_not_found: This record no longer exists, or it is not in your region.
net_conflict: Someone saved this record before you. Reload to see the current version and redo your change.
net_invalid: The server refused the data sent. Check what you filled in and try again.
net_server: The server failed to answer (error {{status}}). This is not your fault: try again in a few minutes and, if it keeps happening, tell the coordination team.
net_unexpected: Something went wrong in the console before the call left. Nothing was sent to the server; reload the page and try again.
entrar_lead: Come and listen. Sign in with the account the coordination team gave you.
entrar_bad_credentials: That email and password do not match. Check both and try again.
entrar_no_role: Your account signed in but holds no Shemá role yet. Ask the Platform admin to grant the role and the region.
entrar_unknown_vocabulary: The server answered with a role or a region this console does not know. The console is behind the API — tell the coordination team before carrying on.
entrar_expired_desc: Sign in again to pick up where you left off. The screen stays open behind this window and nothing you typed was discarded.
entrar_session_note: The session lives in this tab only: reloading the page asks for the password again, and no token is kept in the browser.
record_conflict_title: Someone saved this record while you were editing
record_conflict_kept: Nothing you typed was discarded. The server's version was reloaded underneath what you wrote.
record_conflict_changed_unknown: The record moved, and the server did not say which fields.
record_conflict_overlap: You both touched: {{fields}}. Check those fields before saving again.
record_conflict_no_overlap: None of your fields meets the ones that changed — saving again applies what you typed.
record_save_failed: The save did not go through. What you typed is kept in this browser and can be sent again.
record_invalid_nothing: Nothing was applied: the record stands as it was, and what you typed is still here.
record_saved_withheld: {{tabs}}: what you typed is kept here — this part of the record is not written to the server yet.
record_no_changes: Nothing changed since the last time you saved.
record_nothing_written: Nothing was written to the server.
record_pending_title: Not written to the server yet
record_pending_health: The four health readings, the date and the assessor have a single writer: the Health Assessment, which does not write to the server yet. This tab's prayer request, consent and pastoral answer save normally.
record_pending_media: Photos and videos have no storage path on the server yet. What you attach here is kept in this browser.
record_pending_materials: Translated materials have no storage path on the server yet. What you attach here is kept in this browser.
record_derived_pending: Status, health and time without news are computed by the server and appear after the first save.
link_copy_failed: Could not copy it. Select the address and copy it by hand.
acesso_lead: Who enters the console and the form, with which role and in which regions — and who is on each project's team.
acesso_denied_title: This area belongs to the Platform admin
acesso_denied_body: This screen belongs to the Platform admin: it is where the admin grants and revokes the console's and the form's roles. Your account enters the console with another role.
acesso_search_hint: The search matches the exact e-mail, never part of it — so it never points at the wrong person.
acesso_search_empty: Look someone up by e-mail to see and change their roles, regions and projects.
acesso_no_account: No account uses {{email}}. Someone without an account comes in through an invitation.
acesso_admin_both_apps: One role for both apps: granting or revoking it here writes it in the console and in the form.
acesso_regions_required: Select at least one region: a regional role with no region reaches nothing.
acesso_regional_rule: The regional roles — {{roles}} — only count with at least one region. The regions selected are the person's whole scope: they apply to all of their regional roles and replace the previous ones. Revoking the last regional role clears the regions.
acesso_confirm_last_regional: It is this person's last regional role: their regions go with it.
acesso_confirm_admin_body: {{person}} will grant and revoke every role, in both apps.
acesso_members_gap: The search does not list the projects this person belongs to yet. Pick a project to see its team and add or remove {{person}}.
acesso_members_no_projects: No project to pick in this console.
acesso_members_same_list: It is the same list the record's Team tab shows.
acesso_member_since: {{person}} has been a member of this project since {{date}}.
acesso_member_not: {{person}} is not a member of this project.
acesso_member_remove_warning: The person leaves this project's team. Removing does not erase the history: what they sent stays the project's.
acesso_invites_lead: For someone who has no account yet. The link has a deadline, works once and only for the invited e-mail.
acesso_invite_no_admin: The Platform admin is never sent by invitation: it is granted to an account that already exists.
acesso_invite_once: Copy it now: the link does not show again, not even in the invitation list below.
acesso_invite_email_sent: The e-mail with the link went out to {{email}}.
acesso_invite_email_not_sent: The e-mail did not go out. Hand the link over another way.
acesso_invites_empty: No open invitation. Invitations nobody accepted show up here, each with its state.
acesso_invite_revoke_body: The link stops working. If the person still needs to come in, send a new invitation.
acesso_pending_lead: Projects the board approved on a request sent through the external link. Check the details, mark the sensitive country if needed and fill in the e-mails: only after you confirm does the project show in Projects and the invitations get created.
acesso_pending_members_hint: Whoever already has an account joins the team; whoever does not gets an invitation. Without an e-mail, the person stays out for now.
acesso_pending_discard_body: The request stays approved and without a project. Say why this project does not enter the PME.
acesso_pending_discard_reason_required: A reason is required to discard.
acesso_pending_discarded: {{name}} was discarded. The request stays approved and without a project.
acesso_pending_confirmed: {{name}} confirmed — the project now shows in Projects.
acesso_pending_without_email: Without an e-mail, off the team for now: {{names}}.
acesso_pending_invite_once: Copy it now: the link does not show again. The invitation stays in the list below, without the link.
acesso_history_note: The 200 most recent grants and revocations, of roles and of regions. The admin shows twice, once per app.
acesso_history_empty: No grant or revocation recorded yet.
acesso_history_unknown_account: an account that no longer exists
acesso_history_role_granted_anon: {{role}} ({{app}}) granted to {{person}}, with no author recorded
acesso_history_role_revoked_anon: {{role}} ({{app}}) revoked from {{person}}, with no author recorded
acesso_history_region_granted_anon: The {{region}} region given to {{person}}, with no author recorded
acesso_history_region_revoked_anon: The {{region}} region taken from {{person}}, with no author recorded
convite_gives: This invitation gives you access to the {{app}} as {{role}}.
convite_signup_lead: Create your account to accept. The e-mail is the invitation's.
convite_signin_lead: An account with this e-mail already exists. Sign in with its password to accept.
convite_name_hint: It is how the team will see you. You can leave it blank.
convite_account_exists: An account with this e-mail already exists. Sign in with its password to accept.
convite_other_email: This invitation belongs to another e-mail. Sign in with the invited e-mail's account.
convite_account_created: Your account was created, but the invitation was not accepted. Do not create another: sign in with this one, and if the invitation no longer works ask the Platform admin for a new one.
convite_accepted: Invitation accepted. Welcome to the console.
convite_missing_body: Open the link exactly as it arrived in the e-mail, or ask the Platform admin for a new invitation.
convite_not_found_body: Check that the link is complete, or ask the Platform admin for a new invitation.
convite_expired_body: Every invitation has a deadline. Ask the Platform admin for a new one.
convite_used_body: Sign in to the console with the account that accepted it.
convite_revoked_body: The Platform admin withdrew this invitation. If you still need to come in, ask for a new one.
convite_unknown_role_title: This invitation is not for this console
convite_unknown_role_body: It grants a role this console does not know. Ask the Platform admin for a new invitation.
oracao_authorized_only: Only the requests the teams authorized for the intercessor network appear here.
oracao_pulse_count_one: {{count}} request goes into this Pulse. Check the text below before saving.
oracao_pulse_count_other: {{count}} requests go into this Pulse. Check the text below before saving.
oracao_pulse_no_recall: Once sent to the network, the Pulse cannot be recalled. Withdrawing a request later only removes it from future Pulses.
notif_served_health: {{name}} was assessed as critical on {{date}}. Open the project record to read the assessment and decide what support to offer.
notif_served_health_undated: {{name}} was assessed as critical. Open the project record to read the assessment and decide what support to offer.
notif_served_field: {{who}} submitted the monthly Pulse for {{name}}. Open the project to review it.
notif_served_prayer: The Pulse received for {{name}} carries a prayer request the team has shared with the network. Open the project to read it.
notif_served_prayer_review: A prayer request the team of {{name}} shared is waiting for the coordination's review before it reaches the wall and the Pulse.
notif_served_stale_one: {{name}} has had no progress update for {{count}} day. Open the project to check in.
notif_served_stale_other: {{name}} has had no progress update for {{count}} days. Open the project to check in.
notif_served_stale_unknown: {{name}} has had no progress update in a while. Open the project to check in.
notif_served_old_prayer: A Pulse carried a prayer request shared with the network.
notif_served_old_prayer_review: A sensitive project's prayer request is waiting for the coordination's review.
notif_served_old_stale: A project has had no progress update.
export_needs_server: The export is built by the server, and this build is not connected to one. No file is built in this browser.
export_keep_working: You can close this window and keep working: the file is saved when it finishes.
import_coordination_only: Importing belongs to coordination: it writes whole records, which only coordination reads. If projects need restoring, talk to your region's coordination.
import_preview_kept: Projects not in the file stay as they are — nothing is deleted.
import_preview_prayer: The file authorizes no prayer request: authorization is always the team's, on the record, and a request the file brings changed needs it again.
import_preview_server_fields: What the server derives — health, history, media — is not taken from the file and will be ignored.
import_confirm_server: Each project in the file will be saved over the record with the same id, and the ones that do not exist will be created. If one fails, none goes in.
import_ignored_fields: The server does not take these from a file and ignored them: {{fields}}.
notif_prefs_unread: Your saved preferences could not be read — what shows below is the default, not your choice, and Save stays closed until they are read.
f_public_name_hint: What every reader outside coordination sees instead of the language's name, because the name can name the place. While it is empty, "Sensitive project" shows with the region.
d_public_name_missing: Not registered — other readers see "Sensitive project" with the region
senha_forgot_lead: Tell us your account's e-mail. If it is registered in Shemá, we send a link to choose a new password.
senha_sent_title: If the e-mail is registered, the link is on its way
senha_sent_body: Open the link you received — it is good for one hour. Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder and the address you typed. This screen answers the same for any address, registered or not.
senha_reset_lead: Type the new password twice. Saving signs this account out of every open session.
senha_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
senha_done_body: Sign in with the new password. This account's older sessions were signed out.
senha_missing_title: This address does not carry a reset link
senha_missing_body: Open the link exactly as it arrived in the e-mail, or ask for a new one.
senha_refused_body: It is invalid, expired or already used — each link is good for one hour and one change. Ask for a new one.
forms_q_image: A picture of the work — the team, the elders, the printed material.
forms_q_image_description: Describe the picture: who is in it, where, what is happening.
forms_q_image_authorization: I authorize Shemá to use this picture beyond this project.
intake_authorization_hint: Without this box, the picture stays with coordination and does not leave the project.
intake_image_hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB. The photo is reduced before it goes up.
intake_image_err_type: Format not accepted — use JPEG, PNG or WebP.
intake_image_err_size: The picture is over 10 MB even after reduction. Choose another.
intake_image_err_unreadable: This picture could not be read. Choose another.
intake_err_image: The picture did not reach the server. Choose it again.
forms_submission_withheld: This Pulse's answers belong to a project in a sensitive country, and only coordination reads them.
forms_submission_image_attached: Picture attached — it stays with coordination until the Pulse is imported; the screen does not show it yet.
